title: 은행에서 환전하기: 한국 돈으로 바꿔 주세요
objective: You can ask a teller to change money and react with -네요.
summary: A bank-counter conversation about changing money into won.
setting: A bank counter in Seoul. A customer wants to change US dollars into Korean won.

task.title: Use exchange expressions
task.line: Read each item, then choose, change, or write the Korean that fits the situation.

words.meaning: money exchange (changing one currency into another)
words.exampleMeaning: Can I exchange money at the airport?
The exchange rate changes every day.
Please change these yen into Korean money.

words.meaning: a 10,000-won bill (-짜리: a bill or item worth that amount)

words.exampleMeaning: Please check the amount on the receipt.

words.meaning: ending for reacting to something you just saw or noticed (stem + 네요)
words.exampleMeaning: The line is short today (I see).

dialogue.meaning: I'd like to change dollars into Korean money.
Sure. How much would you like to change?
300 dollars. How is the exchange rate today?

dialogue.korean: 여기 화면 보세요. 지난주보다 조금 올랐어요.
dialogue.meaning: Please look at this screen. It went up a little from last week.
Oh, it's better than last week.

dialogue.korean: 네, 여기 있습니다. 한번 확인해 보세요.
dialogue.meaning: Here you are. Please check it.

dialogue.korean: 네, 맞아요. 와, 금방 끝나네요. 감사합니다.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, it's right. Wow, that was quick. Thank you.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 미국 돈을 한국 돈으로 (환율 / 환전)하고 싶어요. ② 환전이 (금방 / 확인) 끝났어요. ③ 받은 돈을 다시 (섞어 / 확인해) 보세요.
Change the word in brackets into the -네요 form: ① 오늘 환율이 (낮다). ② 은행 직원이 정말 (친절하다). ③ 이 은행은 사람이 (없다).
Read and answer in English. What bills does the customer want?: 손님: 이 유로를 한국 돈으로 바꿔 주세요. / 직원: 네, 오만 원짜리로 드릴까요? / 손님: 아니요, 만 원짜리로 주세요.
You need 1,000-won bills. Ask the teller in Korean (one sentence):
The exchange took only two minutes. React in Korean using 빠르다 and -네요:
answers: ① 환전 ② 금방 ③ 확인해
① 낮네요 ② 친절하네요 ③ 없네요
천 원짜리로 주세요. (천 원짜리로 바꿔 주세요.)
